name: Sharp Unmasking
description: Lift the mask from a foe's qi with a sharp rap of two fingers on the wrist.

name: Matched Candor
description: Strike with both palms together from two angles each as plain as the other.

name: Pair Sight
description: Watch a foe with two sights at once and hold whatever they disagree on.

name: Courtly Guard
description: Set a guard on each side of the body so a blow from either meets plain qi.

name: Second Unmasking
description: Take the second layer of a foe's disguise from him once the first has fallen.

name: Binding Ruling
description: Rule on the unmasked foe and press the finding upon his limbs and breath.

name: Joint Edge
description: Cut with the edge of the hand and the second court's edge in one joined stroke.

name: Stripped Aegis
description: Strip a foe's best shield of qi from him in one clap and leave his body without cover.

name: Verdict Spear
description: Drive a narrow spear of clear ruling through the stripped guard to the heart of the foe.

name: Unmasked Reckoning
description: Pass the court's reckoning through the qi field onto the bare foe so that no guard bars it.

name: Still Clarity
description: Pool clear qi in the belly until it is so still that no false thought can cloud it.

name: Still Water Palm
description: Push a palm forward from the basin and let the clear qi land without a ripple.

name: Still Sight
description: Look into the still pool and see the shape of the one who stands over it.

name: Level Surface
description: Hold a level surface of clear qi before the body so blows run flat across it.

name: Floating Lie
description: Make a foe's lie float to the top of the basin where everyone can see what it is.

name: Clear Weight
description: Press the weight of the clear basin down on a foe until he stops pretending.

name: Clear Rim
description: Break the rim of the basin outward in a ring of clear qi that strips glamour as it goes.

name: Depth Look
description: Look down through the pool to the bottom and read what a foe has sunk out of sight.

name: Overflowing Clarity
description: Pour the basin out through the qi field and wash every illusion and charm from the ground.

name: Fact Hunter
description: Hunt out the one bare fact in a crowd of claims and mark where it lies.

name: Raptor Palm
description: Drop a palm onto the one point the sight has marked and nowhere else.

name: Height Step
description: Rise on a light spring to a height from which the whole ground lies plain.

name: Winged Guard
description: Sweep an arm like a wing across a cut and send it high and wide.

name: Keen Focus
description: Narrow the whole qi sense to a single bright point and let it steer the next blows.

name: Naked Aim
description: Take the aim from a position where the foe's guard is shown as it truly is.

name: Bare Sight
description: Clear the field below of every false image so that each foe stands in his own shape.

name: Piercing Sight
description: Pierce the cover of a hiding foe with a narrow ray of clear sight.

name: Fact Stoop
description: Stoop on a foe from above the instant the bare fact of his position is plain.

name: Naming Descent
description: Fall from the height with the foe's true weakness named and break the guard on landing.

name: Height Reading
description: Read the whole field from the height and mark each hidden thing and each false front.

name: Naked Fact
description: Drop the bare fact upon the foe through the qi field in a stroke no defence can answer.

name: Candid Speech
description: Speak plainly and let the qi ride the words so the body keeps its word.

name: Carried Word
description: Send a spoken word on the wind as a hard bolt of clear qi that lands on the target.

name: Carried Hearing
description: Hear what is said on the wind and note which words die before they reach the ear.

name: Frank Guard
description: Stand in the open with a guard that hides nothing and still turns the cut.

name: Lie Dispersal
description: Scatter a lie in the air with a sharp breath so it reaches no ear.

name: Word Weight
description: Give a plain statement the weight of a stone and set it on a foe's chest.

name: Spoken Edge
description: Say the cut aloud and strike it in the same breath so word and blow cannot be parted.

name: Sworn Candor
description: Bind a foe to the truth of his own last statement until he cannot act against it.

name: Candid Gale
description: Raise a gale of plain words and clear qi that sweeps the ground of every falsehood and foe.

name: Truth Delivered
description: Deliver the one plain truth the foe has fled from in a blow that cannot be turned.

name: Unfenced Sense
description: Open the qi sense wide over the ground with nothing held back from its reach.

name: Bare Palm
description: Push a palm forward that conceals nothing of its force or direction.

name: Lateral Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with an arm that is held wide and plainly in view.

name: Candour Stride
description: Stride out across open ground with the whole body in plain sight.

name: Concealed Mark
description: Pick out the single hidden watcher on the ground and fix where he stands.

name: Falsehood Net
description: Spread a net of sense that catches every false word and hidden intent across the ground.

name: Cover Strip
description: Strip the cover from every hidden foe within the net and leave them in plain view.

name: Naked Bearing
description: Strike along a bearing the sense has made certain so the blow lands without a miss.

name: Truth Burden
description: Spread an expanse of plain truth over the ground and press low every foe whose cause is false.

name: Unveiling Surge
description: Surge the clear sense outward in a wave that strips and strikes everything hidden on the ground.

name: Total Revelation
description: Cast the sense across the whole ground through the qi field and cancel every hidden and false thing in it.

name: Exact Heading
description: Fix the heading of the target through all the noise and hold to it with the sense.

name: Unerring Palm
description: Throw a palm along the held heading so it cannot be led off by a feint.

name: Truing Guard
description: Plant the guard on the heading and take the blow on the line the sense has set.

name: Held Truth
description: Hold a plain truth steady in the mind and let it guide each limb along the heading.

name: Storm Piercer
description: Pierce a storm of illusion in a straight line that does not bend for any image.

name: Oath Steady
description: Stand on the sworn bearing and hold a ward that will not move for any show.

name: Bearing True
description: Strike along a bearing proved true by sense and oath and allow nothing to turn it.

name: Illusion Wake
description: Leave a wake of clear qi behind the strike that dissolves every illusion it crosses.

name: Unerring End
description: Send the sworn bearing through the qi field to its end and pierce whatever stands there.
